clue.text: Start during long vac before university class

parts.note: during means in, as in 'in the night'
the long vacation of British universities centres on August, abbreviated AUG
a class or grade is a rate, as in first-rate

explanation.surface: A student is told to begin a class at the start of the summer break, before term even starts.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'long vac' is the long summer vacation at British universities, of which August is the heart.
explanation.definitionFit: To inaugurate something is to begin it formally, a close synonym of start as a verb.

clue.text: Rosemary perhaps, the female bishop

parts.note: her is the female pronoun
B is the chess notation for bishop

explanation.surface: A woman named Rosemary is introduced as a newly appointed female bishop.
explanation.walkthrough: Rosemary looks like a woman's name, but it is the kitchen plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Rosemary is an example of a culinary plant of this kind, hence the 'perhaps'.

clue.text: The courts imprisoning one hundred and fifty? That's dramatic

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: imprisoning means the courts word holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: atria are courts or open central halls of a building
C is the Roman numeral for one hundred
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether law courts locking up a hundred and fifty people would be a dramatic event.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'courts' are not law courts but atria, open halls; 'one hundred and fifty' splits into two Roman numerals.
explanation.definitionFit: Theatrical and dramatic are synonyms, both describing behaviour or effects suited to the stage.

clue.text: Armour that could be first class

definitions.meaning: chain armour made of linked rings
post, which can be sent first class

explanation.definitionFit: Mail is both linked-ring armour and the post, which may go first or second class.

clue.text: See grub served out, spreading happiness around — convenience food

indicators.note: around means the happiness word wraps the rearranged letters

parts.note: to spread happiness is to give cheer

indicators.note: food served out is dished around, so these letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone serves up a meal with a smile, the whole thing being quick fast food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'served out' is the anagram signal, and 'spreading happiness' supplies the outer word that goes 'around' it; the definition is only the last two words.
explanation.definitionFit: A burger with cheese is a classic fast food, the type of ready meal called convenience food.

clue.text: Back from work, perhaps gathers around me and wife

indicators.note: around means the gathering word wraps the other pieces

parts.note: to gather up and store is to hoard, so gathers is hoards
taken as written
W is the abbreviation for wife in genealogies

explanation.surface: A worker heads back from the job, perhaps collecting things around themselves and their spouse.
explanation.definitionFit: Heading back from work typically means travelling towards one's house, an example of the direction meant.

clue.text: Mark part of the digestive system

definitions.meaning: a punctuation mark of two dots

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a two-dot punctuation mark and the main section of the large intestine.

clue.text: Some unhappy Londoners in the Tower

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some miserable Londoners are locked up in the Tower of London.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The Tower' suggests the Tower of London, but here it is a tower carrying power cables.
explanation.definitionFit: A pylon is a tall steel tower that carries overhead electricity lines, so it is a kind of tower.

clue.text: Is girl joining team an unwelcome distraction?

indicators.note: joining says the team word is attached to the other pieces, which come after it in the answer

parts.note: a side is a team in sport
taken as written
Sue is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether letting a girl join the team would only be a nuisance.
explanation.definitionFit: A matter of secondary importance that draws attention from the main point is an unwelcome distraction.

clue.text: This nutcase, I fancy, is passionate

indicators.note: fancy as an adjective means elaborate or fanciful, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone describes a madman they find attractive as being very passionate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I fancy' reads as 'I think', but 'fancy' shuffles THIS NUTCASE I.
explanation.definitionFit: Being keen and passionate about something is a direct synonym of the answer's meaning.

clue.text: Quiet old politician in ceremony

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A retired politician stays quiet during an official ceremony.
explanation.definitionFit: Pomp is splendid ceremonial display, so it stands for ceremony.

clue.text: Office assistant cheeky, one deceptive about written documentation

parts.note: a PA is a personal assistant in an office
pert means saucy or cheeky

indicators.note: about means the deceiver's word is turned round

parts.note: a liar is one who deceives

explanation.surface: A cheeky office assistant is accused of lying about the paperwork.
explanation.definitionFit: A trail of written records showing what was done is a body of documentation.

clue.text: Bit missing from savoury dish, so blood-red?

indicators.note: missing from means the named piece is taken away from the dish word

parts.note: Welsh rarebit is a savoury dish of cheese on toast
taken as written

explanation.surface: A piece is missing from a savoury dish, which a diner wonders is undercooked and bloody.
explanation.walkthrough: Welsh RAREBIT is a British dish of melted cheese on toast; the question mark marks 'blood-red' as a playful description of rare meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Meat cooked rare is still red and bloody inside, so blood-red is a whimsical description.

clue.text: Consent for each assignment

parts.note: per means for each, as in 'per head'
a mission is an assigned task

explanation.surface: Approval is sought for each task given.
explanation.definitionFit: Permission is the formal giving of consent, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Keen on set of holy books, I love to provide binding

indicators.note: providing a binding means the outer letters wrap round the books like a cover

parts.note: taken as written
love is zero in tennis, the letter O
NT is the New Testament

explanation.surface: A devotee of the scriptures loves rebinding the holy books.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to provide binding' puts NT between I and O, like a book cover.
explanation.definitionFit: Being into something informally means being keen on it or enthusiastic about it.

clue.text: Port with a cargo, left for unloading

indicators.note: unloading means taking something off, so the named letter is removed

parts.note: laden means loaded with a cargo

explanation.surface: A ship arrives at a port with cargo and leaves it there for unloading.
explanation.definitionFit: Aden is a seaport in Yemen, on the Gulf of Aden.

clue.text: Become worried, as parent with flatulent baby must

definitions.meaning: to become frightened or anxious, idiomatically

definitions.text: as parent with flatulent baby must
definitions.meaning: a parent must literally bring up a baby's trapped gas

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to become nervous, and literally describes bringing up a baby's trapped gas.

clue.text: Amplify worship that lacks piano

indicators.note: lacking something means being without it, so the named letter is removed

parts.note: praise is worship
P is the musical abbreviation for piano

explanation.surface: A request to turn up the volume of the hymn singing, since there is no piano.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise sound or volume is to make it greater, synonymous with amplify.

clue.text: Went over poetry in a sort of jazzy setting

indicators.note: in means the poetry piece sits inside the jazz word
setting means the jazz word frames the poetry like a mount

parts.note: trad is traditional jazz, a sort of jazz
verse is poetry

explanation.surface: Someone recited poems against a jazz backing.
explanation.walkthrough: TRAD is short for traditional jazz, a British name for revivalist New Orleans-style jazz.
explanation.definitionFit: To traverse is to cross or go over, so the past tense means went over.

clue.text: Spinning line, TV sage is proclaimer of message

indicators.note: spinning turns things round and round, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A wise man on television spins a line while preaching his message.
explanation.definitionFit: An evangelist is a preacher who spreads the gospel, a proclaimer of the Christian message.

clue.text: Beautiful girl receiving band of gold, perhaps lover finally participant at church?

indicators.note: receiving means the girl takes the next piece inside her

parts.note: a belle is a beautiful girl
a ring is a band, often of gold

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word lover

explanation.surface: A beautiful bride receives a gold ring from her lover in a church wedding.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface paints a wedding, but the participant is the person ringing the bells.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone ringing church bells takes part in church life, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Religious record I hand one's biblical song

parts.note: a religious, as a noun, is a nun or monk
a CD is a compact disc record
taken as written
mitt is slang for hand
one is I, and 's stands for is, giving S

explanation.surface: A nun hands over a recording of a song from the Bible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Religious' is a noun here: a member of a religious order.
explanation.definitionFit: The canticle of Simeon from Luke's Gospel, sung at evensong, is a biblical song.

clue.text: Manageress hopes to be seen as such a high-street trader?

definitions.text: Manageress hopes to be seen as such a high-street trader?

parts.words: Manageress hopes to be seen as such a high-street trader?
parts.note: a woman running a store hopes customers see her as one who keeps a shop on the main street

explanation.definitionFit: A person running a retail shop on a high street, the main street of a British town, is a retail trader of this kind.

clue.text: Grandfather is not such an insignificant person

definitions.meaning: a grandfather clock is a big timepiece, not a little one

explanation.definitionFit: A minor figure of little importance is a nobody, while a grandfather clock is a large timepiece.

clue.text: Banish revolutionary understood to be engaged in subterfuge

indicators.note: being engaged in something means being held inside it

parts.note: a ruse is a trick or subterfuge

indicators.note: revolutionary means turning round, so the understood word is read backwards

parts.note: tacit means implied or understood without being said

explanation.surface: A revolutionary is exiled for being involved in a covert plot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' looks like the person banished, but it is the reversal signal; 'to be engaged in' marks the container. Rusticating is the Oxbridge term for sending a student away.
explanation.definitionFit: To rusticate is to send away, especially to suspend a student from university, a kind of banishment.

clue.text: State of water that's run out of small river

indicators.note: out of means the named letter leaves the river word

parts.note: a stream is a small river
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A small river has run dry.
explanation.definitionFit: Water exists as liquid, ice or vapour, the last being one of its physical states.

clue.text: Island has one scientific establishment set up

indicators.note: has here means the island word takes the numeral on after the turned laboratory
set up in a down clue means turned upwards, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a lab is a laboratory
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An island has a research laboratory built on it.
explanation.definitionFit: Bali is an Indonesian island, an example of the class named.

clue.text: Group of people without defect, but heartless

indicators.note: heartless means losing the middle letter of the word

parts.note: clean means spotless, without defect

explanation.surface: A group of people is flawless but lacks compassion.
explanation.definitionFit: A clan is a family group or tribe of related people.
